messages:
james: quick audit/CR ping — I'm updating the API contract for model selection: change to /v1/serve to include explicit served_model_id + fallback_chain. Need signoff on compatibility and tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 :eyes:

maria: skimmed the PR. Two quick questions: 1) if client sets model_pin and region_hint that can't be satisfied, are we returning 409 or falling back to variant? 2) will served_model_id always be present in 200 responses?

saurabh: policy doc says prefer honoring model_pin; fallback only if pin not available anywhere but a compatible variant exists. Proposed API: 200 + served_model_id when we successfully serve a variant, include "fallback_reason":"region_unavailable|quantized_variant". 409 if pin required by client (enforced by param enforce_pin=true). See code snippet:
```
{
  "status": "ok",
  "served_model_id": "rwkv-3b-q4a",
  "fallback_chain": ["rwkv-3b-q8"],
  "fallback_reason": "region_unavailable"
}
```

claire: CR pinged. Tests failing on integration — the response shape changed so the SDK deserialization breaks. Can we keep served_model_id optional and add a compatibility header `X-Model-Compat: v1`?

james: good catch. let's make served_model_id optional for v1 clients. Add an integration-level compatibility flag `compat_version` in response meta. I'll update PR. Also adding unit tests for routing TTL and region fallback.

ops-bot: deploy-preview created for branch routing-param-audit: https://deploy.redwood.ai/preview/4821 — tests: 42/45 passed, 3 flaky failing (batching). :robot_face:

maria: leaving notes in PR about SDK change. If we set `enforce_pin=true`, we should 409 with body explaining available variants and regions. Suggested 409 body:
```
{
  "error": "Model pin not available in region",
  "available": ["us-east-1:rwkv-3b-q4a","eu-west-1:rwkv-3b-q4b"],
  "hint": "set enforce_pin=false to allow compatible fallback"
}
```

saurabh: agree. Also add a lint rule to route param schema: region_hint must be one of supported regions or 'any'. I'll add a quick patch.

claire: once tests stable, happy to approve. James — can you add a short entry in the API change log and a one-line note in the SDK migration guide?

james: on it. I'll merge after CI green. Thanks all. :tada:
